1.english_reference: Josiah [ was ] eight years old when he began to reign

traditions.WLC: בֶּן שְׁמֹנֶ֤ה שָׁנָה֙ יֹאשִׁיָּ֣הוּ בְ מָלְכ֔ וֹ
traditions.LXX: Υἱὸς ὀκτὼ ἐτῶν Ἰωσείας ἐν τῷ βασιλεύειν αὐτόν ,
traditions.VUL: Octo annórum erat Iosías cum regnáre cœpísset ,
traditions.KJV: Josiah [ was ] eight years old when he began to reign ,

1.english_reference: and he reigned thirty and one years in Jerusalem

traditions.WLC: וּ שְׁלֹשִׁ֤ים וְ אַחַת֙ שָׁנָ֔ה מָלַ֖ךְ בִּ ירוּשָׁלִָ֑ם
traditions.LXX: καὶ τριάκοντα καὶ ἓν ἔτος ἐβασίλευσεν ἐν Ἰερουσαλήμ ,
traditions.VUL: trigínta et uno anno regnávit in Ierúsalem :
traditions.KJV: and he reigned thirty and one years in Jerusalem .

1.english_reference: And his mother ’s name [ was ] Jedidah , the daughter of Adaiah of Boscath

traditions.WLC: וְ שֵׁ֣ם אִמּ֔ וֹ יְדִידָ֥ה בַת עֲדָ֖יָה מִ בָּצְקַֽת
traditions.LXX: καὶ ὄνομα τῇ μητρὶ αὐτοῦ Ἰεδειὰ θυγάτηρ Ἐδεινὰ ἐκ Βασουρώθ .
traditions.VUL: nomen matris eius Idída fília Hadaía de Bésecath .
traditions.KJV: And his mother ’s name [ was ] Jedidah , the daughter of Adaiah of Boscath .

2.english_reference: And he did [ that which was ] right in the sight of the LORD

traditions.WLC: וַ יַּ֥עַשׂ הַ יָּשָׁ֖ר בְּ עֵינֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐποίησεν τὸ εὐθὲς ἐν ὀφθαλμοῖς Κυρίου ,
traditions.VUL: Fecítque quod plácitum erat coram Dómino ,
traditions.KJV: And he did [ that which was ] right in the sight of the LORD ,

2.english_reference: and walked in all the way of David his father

traditions.WLC: וַ יֵּ֗לֶךְ בְּ כָל דֶּ֨רֶךְ֙ דָּוִ֣ד אָבִ֔י
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐπορεύθη ἐν πάσῃ ὁδῷ Δαυεὶδ τοῦ πατρὸς αὐτοῦ ·
traditions.VUL: et ambulávit per omnes vias David patris sui :
traditions.KJV: and walked in all the way of David his father ,

2.english_reference: and turned not aside to the right hand or to the left

traditions.WLC: ו וְ לֹא סָ֖ר יָמִ֥ין וּ שְׂמֹֽאול
traditions.LXX: οὐκ ἀπέστη δεξιὰ καὶ ἀριστερά .
traditions.VUL: non declinávit ad déxteram , sive ad sinístram .
traditions.KJV: and turned not aside to the right hand or to the left .

3.english_reference: And it came to pass in the eighteenth year of king Josiah

traditions.WLC: וַ יְהִ֗י בִּ שְׁמֹנֶ֤ה עֶשְׂרֵה֙ שָׁנָ֔ה לַ מֶּ֖לֶךְ יֹאשִׁיָּ֑הוּ
traditions.LXX: Καὶ ἐγενήθη ἐν τῷ ὀκτωκαιδεκάτῳ ἔτει τῷ βασιλεῖ Ἰωσείᾳ , ἐν τῷ μηνὶ τῷ ὀγδόῳ ,
traditions.VUL: Anno autem octávo décimo regis Iosíæ ,
traditions.KJV: And it came to pass in the eighteenth year of king Josiah , [ that ]

3.english_reference: [ that ] the king sent Shaphan the son of Azaliah , the son of Meshullam , the scribe , to the house of the LORD

traditions.WLC: שָׁלַ֣ח הַ֠ מֶּלֶךְ אֶת שָׁפָ֨ן בֶּן אֲצַלְיָ֤הוּ בֶן מְשֻׁלָּם֙ הַ סֹּפֵ֔ר בֵּ֥ית יְהוָ֖ה
traditions.LXX: ἀπέστειλεν ὁ βασιλεὺς τὸν Σαφφὰν υἱὸν Ἐλίου υἱοῦ Μεσολλὰμ τὸν γραμματέα οἴκου Κυρίου
traditions.VUL: misit rex Saphan fílium Aslía fílii Méssulam scribam templi Dómini ,
traditions.KJV: the king sent Shaphan the son of Azaliah , the son of Meshullam , the scribe , to the house of the LORD ,

traditions.WLC: לֵ אמֹֽר
traditions.LXX: λέγων
traditions.VUL: dicens ei :
traditions.KJV: saying ,

4.english_reference: Go up to Hilkiah the high priest

traditions.WLC: עֲלֵ֗ה אֶל חִלְקִיָּ֨הוּ֙ הַ כֹּהֵ֣ן הַ גָּד֔וֹל
traditions.LXX: Ἀνάβηθι πρὸς Χελκείαν τὸν ἱερέα τὸν μέγαν
traditions.VUL: Vade ad Helcíam sacerdótem magnum ,
traditions.KJV: Go up to Hilkiah the high priest ,

4.english_reference: that he may sum the silver which is brought into the house of the LORD

traditions.WLC: וְ יַתֵּ֣ם אֶת הַ כֶּ֔סֶף הַ מּוּבָ֖א בֵּ֣ית יְהוָ֑ה
traditions.LXX: καὶ σφράγισον τὸ ἀργύριον τὸ εἰσενεχθὲν ἐν οἴκῳ Κυρίου ,
traditions.VUL: ut conflétur pecúnia , quæ illáta est in templum Dómini ,
traditions.KJV: that he may sum the silver which is brought into the house of the LORD ,

4.english_reference: which the keepers of the door have gathered of the people

traditions.WLC: אֲשֶׁ֥ר אָסְפ֛וּ שֹׁמְרֵ֥י הַ סַּ֖ף מֵ אֵ֥ת הָ עָֽם
traditions.LXX: ὃ συνήγαγον οἱ φυλάσσοντες τὸν σταθμὸν παρὰ τοῦ λαοῦ ,
traditions.VUL: quam collegérunt ianitóres templi a pópulo ,
traditions.KJV: which the keepers of the door have gathered of the people :

5.english_reference: And let them deliver it into the hand of the doers of the work , that have the oversight of the house of the LORD

traditions.WLC: ו יתנ ה עַל יַד֙ עֹשֵׂ֣י הַ מְּלָאכָ֔ה הַ מֻּפְקָדִ֖ים ב בית יְהוָ֑ה
traditions.LXX: καὶ δότωσαν αὐτὸ ἐπὶ χεῖρα ποιούντων τὰ ἔργα τῶν καθεσταμένων ἐν οἴκῳ Κυρίου .
traditions.VUL: detúrque fabris per præpósitos domus Dómini ,
traditions.KJV: And let them deliver it into the hand of the doers of the work , that have the oversight of the house of the LORD :

5.english_reference: and let them give it to the doers of the work which [ is ] in the house of the LORD

traditions.WLC: וְ יִתְּנ֣וּ אֹת֗ וֹ לְ עֹשֵׂ֤י הַ מְּלָאכָה֙ אֲשֶׁר֙ בְּ בֵ֣ית יְהוָ֔ה
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἔδωκεν αὐτὸ τοῖς ποιοῦσιν τὰ ἔργα τοῖς ἐν οἴκῳ Κυρίου ,
traditions.VUL: qui et distríbuant eam his , qui operántur in templo Dómini ,
traditions.KJV: and let them give it to the doers of the work which [ is ] in the house of the LORD ,

5.english_reference: to repair the breaches of the house

traditions.WLC: לְ חַזֵּ֖ק בֶּ֥דֶק הַ בָּֽיִת
traditions.LXX: τοῦ κατισχῦσαι τὸ βέδεκ τοῦ οἴκου ,
traditions.VUL: ad instauránda sartatécta templi :
traditions.KJV: to repair the breaches of the house ,

6.english_reference: Unto carpenters , and builders , and masons

traditions.WLC: לֶ חָ֣רָשִׁ֔ים וְ לַ בֹּנִ֖ים וְ לַ גֹּֽדְרִ֑ים
traditions.LXX: τοῖς τέκτοσιν καὶ τοῖς οἰκοδόμοις καὶ τοῖς τειχισταῖς ,
traditions.VUL: tignáriis vidélicet et cæmentáriis , et iis , qui interrúpta compónunt :
traditions.KJV: Unto carpenters , and builders , and masons ,

6.english_reference: and to buy timber and hewn stone to repair the house

traditions.WLC: וְ לִ קְנ֤וֹת עֵצִים֙ וְ אַבְנֵ֣י מַחְצֵ֔ב לְ חַזֵּ֖ק אֶת הַ בָּֽיִת
traditions.LXX: καὶ τοῦ κτήσασθαι ξύλα καὶ λίθους λατομητοὺς τοῦ κραταιῶσαι τὸ βέδεκ τοῦ οἴκου .
traditions.VUL: et ut emántur ligna , et lápides de lapicidínis , ad instaurándum templum Dómini .
traditions.KJV: and to buy timber and hewn stone to repair the house .

7.english_reference: Howbeit there was no reckoning made with them of the money that was delivered into their hand

traditions.WLC: אַ֚ךְ לֹא יֵחָשֵׁ֣ב אִתָּ֔ ם הַ כֶּ֖סֶף הַ נִּתָּ֣ן עַל יָדָ֑ ם
traditions.LXX: πλὴν οὐκ ἐξελογίζοντο αὐτοὺς τὸ ἀργύριον τὸ διδόμενον αὐτοῖς ,
traditions.VUL: Verúmtamen non supputétur eis argéntum quod accípiunt ,
traditions.KJV: Howbeit there was no reckoning made with them of the money that was delivered into their hand ,

traditions.WLC: כִּ֥י בֶ אֱמוּנָ֖ה הֵ֥ם עֹשִֽׂים
traditions.LXX: ὅτι ἐν πίστει αὐτοὶ ποιοῦσιν .
traditions.VUL: sed in potestáte hábeant , et in fide .
traditions.KJV: because they dealt faithfully .

8.english_reference: And Hilkiah the high priest said unto Shaphan the scribe

traditions.WLC: וַ֠ יֹּאמֶר חִלְקִיָּ֜הוּ הַ כֹּהֵ֤ן הַ גָּדוֹל֙ עַל שָׁפָ֣ן הַ סֹּפֵ֔ר
traditions.LXX: Καὶ εἶπεν Χελκείας ὁ ἱερεὺς ὁ μέγας πρὸς Σαφφὰν τὸν γραμματέα
traditions.VUL: Dixit autem Helcías póntifex ad Saphan scribam :
traditions.KJV: And Hilkiah the high priest said unto Shaphan the scribe ,

8.english_reference: I have found the book of the law in the house of the LORD

traditions.WLC: סֵ֧פֶר הַ תּוֹרָ֛ה מָצָ֖אתִי בְּ בֵ֣ית יְהוָ֑ה
traditions.LXX: Βιβλίον τοῦ νόμου εὗρον ἐν οἴκῳ Κυρίου ·
traditions.VUL: Librum legis réperi in domo Dómini .
traditions.KJV: I have found the book of the law in the house of the LORD .

8.english_reference: And Hilkiah gave the book to Shaphan , and he read it

traditions.WLC: וַ יִּתֵּ֨ן חִלְקִיָּ֧ה אֶת הַ סֵּ֛פֶר אֶל שָׁפָ֖ן וַ יִּקְרָאֵֽ הוּ
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἔδωκεν Χελκείας τὸ βιβλίον πρὸς Σαφφάν , καὶ ἀνέγνω αὐτό .
traditions.VUL: Dedítque Helcías volúmen Saphan , qui et legit illud .
traditions.KJV: And Hilkiah gave the book to Shaphan , and he read it .

9.english_reference: And Shaphan the scribe came to the king , and brought the king word again , and said

traditions.WLC: וַ יָּבֹ֞א שָׁפָ֤ן הַ סֹּפֵר֙ אֶל הַ מֶּ֔לֶךְ וַ יָּ֥שֶׁב אֶת הַ מֶּ֖לֶךְ דָּבָ֑ר וַ יֹּ֗אמֶר
traditions.LXX: καὶ εἰσῆλθεν ἐν οἴκῳ Κυρίου πρὸς τὸν βασιλέα , καὶ ἀπέστρεψεν τῷ βασιλεῖ ῥῆμα καὶ εἶπεν
traditions.VUL: Venit quoque Saphan scriba ad regem , et renuntiávit ei quod præcéperat , et ait :
traditions.KJV: And Shaphan the scribe came to the king , and brought the king word again , and said ,

9.english_reference: Thy servants have gathered the money that was found in the house

traditions.WLC: הִתִּ֤יכוּ עֲבָדֶ֨י ךָ֙ אֶת הַ כֶּ֨סֶף֙ הַ נִּמְצָ֣א בַ בַּ֔יִת
traditions.LXX: Ἐχώνευσαν οἱ δοῦλοί σου τὸ ἀργύριον τὸ εὑρεθὲν ἐν τῷ οἴκῳ Κυρίου ,
traditions.VUL: Conflavérunt servi tui pecúniam , quæ repérta est in domo Dómini ,
traditions.KJV: Thy servants have gathered the money that was found in the house ,

9.english_reference: and have delivered it into the hand of them that do the work , that have the oversight of the house of the LORD

traditions.WLC: וַֽ יִּתְּנֻ֗ הוּ עַל יַד֙ עֹשֵׂ֣י הַ מְּלָאכָ֔ה הַ מֻּפְקָדִ֖ים בֵּ֥ית יְהוָֽה
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἔδωκαν αὐτὸ ἐπὶ χεῖρα ποιούντων τὰ ἔργα καθεσταμένων ἐν οἴκῳ Κυρίου .
traditions.VUL: et dedérunt ut distribuerétur fabris a præféctis óperum templi Dómini .
traditions.KJV: and have delivered it into the hand of them that do the work , that have the oversight of the house of the LORD .

10.english_reference: And Shaphan the scribe shewed the king , saying , Hilkiah the priest hath delivered me a book

traditions.WLC: וַ יַּגֵּ֞ד שָׁפָ֤ן הַ סֹּפֵר֙ לַ מֶּ֣לֶךְ לֵ אמֹ֔ר סֵ֚פֶר נָ֣תַן לִ֔ י חִלְקִיָּ֖ה הַ כֹּהֵ֑ן
traditions.LXX: καὶ εἶπεν Σαφφὰν ὁ γραμματεὺς πρὸς τὸν βασιλέα λὲγων Βιβλίον ἔδωκέν μοι Χελκείας ὁ ἱερεύς ·
traditions.VUL: Narrávit quoque Saphan scriba regi , dicens : Librum dedit mihi Helcías sacérdos .
traditions.KJV: And Shaphan the scribe shewed the king , saying , Hilkiah the priest hath delivered me a book .

10.english_reference: And Shaphan read it before the king

traditions.WLC: וַ יִּקְרָאֵ֥ הוּ שָׁפָ֖ן לִ פְנֵ֥י הַ מֶּֽלֶךְ
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἀνέγνω αὐτὸ Σαφφὰν ἐνώπιον τοῦ βασιλέως .
traditions.VUL: Quem cum legísset Saphan coram rege ,
traditions.KJV: And Shaphan read it before the king .

11.english_reference: And it came to pass , when the king had heard the words of the book of the law ,

traditions.WLC: וַֽ יְהִי֙ כִּ שְׁמֹ֣עַ הַ מֶּ֔לֶךְ אֶת דִּבְרֵ֖י סֵ֣פֶר הַ תּוֹרָ֑ה
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐγένετο ὡς ἤκουσεν ὁ βασιλεὺς τοὺς λόγους βιβλίου τοῦ νόμου ,
traditions.VUL: et audísset rex verba libri legis Dómini ,
traditions.KJV: And it came to pass , when the king had heard the words of the book of the law ,

traditions.WLC: וַ יִּקְרַ֖ע אֶת בְּגָדָֽי ו
traditions.LXX: καὶ διέρρηξεν τὰ ἱμάτια ἑαυτοῦ .
traditions.VUL: scidit vestiménta sua .
traditions.KJV: that he rent his clothes .

12.english_reference: And the king commanded Hilkiah the priest , and Ahikam the son of Shaphan , and Achbor the son of Michaiah , and Shaphan the scribe , and Asahiah a servant of the king ’s ,

traditions.WLC: וַ יְצַ֣ו הַ מֶּ֡לֶךְ אֶת חִלְקִיָּ֣ה הַ כֹּהֵ֡ן וְ אֶת אֲחִיקָ֣ם בֶּן שָׁ֠פָן וְ אֶת עַכְבּ֨וֹר בֶּן מִיכָיָ֜ה וְ אֵ֣ת שָׁפָ֣ן הַ סֹּפֵ֗ר וְ אֵ֛ת עֲשָׂיָ֥ה עֶֽבֶד הַ מֶּ֖לֶךְ
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐνετείλατο ὁ βασιλεὺς τῷ Χελκείᾳ τῷ ἱερεῖ καὶ τῷ Ἀχεικὰμ υἱῷ Σαφφὰν καὶ τῷ Ἀχοβὼρ υἱῷ Μειχαίου καὶ τῷ Σαφφὰν τῷ γραμματεῖ καὶ τῷ Ἀσαίᾳ δούλῳ τοῦ βασιλέως
traditions.VUL: Et præcépit Helcíæ sacerdóti , et Ahicam fílio Saphan , et Achobor fílio Micha , et Saphan scribæ , et Asaíæ servo regis ,
traditions.KJV: And the king commanded Hilkiah the priest , and Ahikam the son of Shaphan , and Achbor the son of Michaiah , and Shaphan the scribe , and Asahiah a servant of the king ’s ,

traditions.WLC: לֵ אמֹֽר
traditions.LXX: λέγων
traditions.VUL: dicens :
traditions.KJV: saying ,

13.english_reference: Go ye , inquire of the LORD for me , and for the people , and for all Judah , concerning the words of this book that is found :

traditions.WLC: לְכוּ֩ דִרְשׁ֨וּ אֶת יְהוָ֜ה בַּעֲדִ֣ י וּ בְעַד הָ עָ֗ם וּ בְעַד֙ כָּל יְהוּדָ֔ה עַל דִּבְרֵ֛י הַ סֵּ֥פֶר הַ נִּמְצָ֖א הַ זֶּ֑ה
traditions.LXX: Δεῦτε καὶ ἐκζητήσατε τὸν κύριον περὶ ἐμοῦ καὶ περὶ παντὸς τοῦ λαοῦ καὶ περὶ παντὸς τοῦ Ἰούδα καὶ περὶ τῶν λόγων τοῦ βιβλίου τοῦ εὑρεθέντος τούτου ,
traditions.VUL: Ite et consúlite Dóminum super me , et super pópulo , et super omni Iuda , de verbis volúminis istíus , quod invéntum est :
traditions.KJV: Go ye , inquire of the LORD for me , and for the people , and for all Judah , concerning the words of this book that is found :

13.english_reference: for great [ is ] the wrath of the LORD that is kindled against us ,

traditions.WLC: כִּֽי גְדוֹלָ֞ה חֲמַ֣ת יְהוָ֗ה אֲשֶׁר הִיא֙ נִצְּתָ֣ה בָ֔ נוּ
traditions.LXX: ὅτι μεγάλη ἡ ὀργὴ Κυρίου ἡ ἐκκεχυμένη ἐν ἡμῖν
traditions.VUL: magna enim ira Dómini succénsa est contra nos ,
traditions.KJV: for great [ is ] the wrath of the LORD that is kindled against us ,

13.english_reference: because our fathers have not hearkened unto the words of this book , to do according unto all that which is written concerning us .

traditions.WLC: עַל֩ אֲשֶׁ֨ר לֹֽא שָׁמְע֜וּ אֲבֹתֵ֗י נוּ עַל דִּבְרֵי֙ הַ סֵּ֣פֶר הַ זֶּ֔ה לַ עֲשׂ֖וֹת כְּ כָל הַ כָּת֥וּב עָלֵֽי נוּ
traditions.LXX: ὑπὲρ οὗ οὐκ ἤκουσαν οἱ πατέρες ἡμῶν τῶν λόγων τοῦ βιβλίου τοῦ ποιεῖν κατὰ πάντα τὰ γεγραμμένα καθ᾽ ἡμῶν .
traditions.VUL: quia non audiérunt patres nostri verba libri huius , ut fácerent omne quod scriptum est nobis .
traditions.KJV: because our fathers have not hearkened unto the words of this book , to do according unto all that which is written concerning us .

14.english_reference: So Hilkiah the priest , and Ahikam , and Achbor , and Shaphan , and Asahiah , went unto Huldah the prophetess ,

traditions.WLC: וַ יֵּ֣לֶךְ חִלְקִיָּ֣הוּ הַ֠ כֹּהֵן וַ אֲחִיקָ֨ם וְ עַכְבּ֜וֹר וְ שָׁפָ֣ן וַ עֲשָׂיָ֗ה אֶל חֻלְדָּ֨ה הַ נְּבִיאָ֜ה

traditions.KJV: all the words of the book which the king of Judah hath read :

17.english_reference: therefore my wrath shall be kindled against this place ,

traditions.VUL: Regi autem Iuda , qui misit vos ut consulerétis Dóminum , sic dicétis :

traditions.KJV: Because thine heart was tender , and thou hast humbled thyself before the LORD ,
